GREG, 2026-11-06 about 05:52Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #364, message ffd66ec3), answering Fable's A/B question. Verbatim: „B. Naprawdę wystarczy.”
AMENDED BY GREG, 2026-11-06 about 16:20Z (Asistant #390, message 2ec544e6), verbatim: „EO nie mialo tego uzywac, mialo sprawdzac tylko stan przed i PO wariant B ABY ... TO UPROSCIC”. And about 16:25Z (Asistant #396, message 9f8c64a4): „ŻADNEGO hashowania katalogu .git” — no hashing of the .git directory at all (the earlier wording limited to .git/info was wrong).
CURRENT OPTION B (TermAl w-24a72c898d6d):
(1) The host takes a rev 5 source_id capture at commit X BEFORE it dispatches the turn's prompt.
(2) The credited declared test is the turn's FIRST tool action; execution identity shows it originates from that turn.
(3) After the run, a clean rev 5 source_id capture at the same commit X.
(4) check.started_at is the host-observed first start reservation.
NOTHING ELSE: no watcher condition of any kind, no hashing or comparison of anything in the .git directory, no submodule scope list, no other gate.
Accepted limit: a change made and fully reverted between the two captures, or anything git status does not report, is not detected. Credited tests run as the first action of a fresh turn.
